lines: Nights slept on local time before kickoff: San Francisco 49ers 7, Los Angeles Rams 1. Acclimation scores 9.85 and 3.7, a gap of 6.15.

What the app did with that: it moved the win chance 1.2 percentage points toward San Francisco 49ers, the gap times 0.002, and it can never move more than 2 points for travel. On the betting line that is worth about 0.4 of a point.

Jet lag, rule of thumb: the body catches up about one hour a day. This venue is 17 hours off, which the body feels as 7 hours. So at kickoff San Francisco 49ers's body clock was about 0 hours off and Los Angeles Rams's about 6.

The most generous case: suppose every hour a body clock is still off costs a team 0.74 of a point on the scoreboard. That is the biggest value our own travel test produced, and the same test showed it does not predict results, so the app does not use it; it is here only to show the ceiling. It would take about 4.4 points from Los Angeles Rams: the line would go from Los Angeles Rams by 3.5 to San Francisco 49ers by 0.9, about 53 to 47.

Final: Los Angeles Rams 7, San Francisco 49ers 27. The result landed 23.5 points past the closing line on San Francisco 49ers's side. Even the most generous travel math explains at most 4.4 of those points; the rest is football.
